about:
Lakeside Steel & Mfg. Co. operates from Kenosha, Wisconsin, where it has served the metal fabrication needs of the power generation industry, material handling, construction equipment, and original equipment manufacturers for over 100 years. The company’s history spans more than a century, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated.

The 41,000-square-foot facility houses a range of in-house processes including plasma and flame cutting, sawing, bending, rolling, punching, certified welding, and painting. A 600-ton hydraulic press brake, four plate rolls, twenty-two welding machines, and multiple overhead cranes support heavy fabrication; the shop has produced weldments as large as 13 feet 6 inches in diameter by 70 feet long weighing over 105,000 pounds. An adjacent 11,000-square-foot warehouse stocks carbon and stainless steel sheet, plate, and structural shapes, enabling rapid material availability. For specialized requirements, Lakeside coordinates stress relieving, blast cleaning, galvanizing, machining, and non-destructive testing through qualified subcontractors.

Customers span power generation, material handling, construction equipment, and OEM sectors. Project examples include combustors, air piping, coal ducts, trommels, inlet water pipes, forklift booms, shaker conveyors, fly ash silos, cement hoppers, explosion-door components, galvanized platforms, and a variety of structural frames and enclosures.

Lakeside emphasizes short lead times through multi-shift operations and an on-site steel inventory that eliminates delivery delays. Its location midway between Chicago and Milwaukee provides direct highway and rail access for nationwide shipping. The company cites its certified craftsmen, heavy-lifting capacity, and commitment to precise, timely fabrication as core differentiators.
